principle.production_mirror: Mirror production contracts, topology mapping, package layout, API/media edge routes, service health, ES/Redis-backed search behavior, and readonly integration probes.
principle.minimal_knowledge_scale: Use the smallest local-gamma knowledge/data scale sufficient to prove production-like behavior: single local stack, one ES data node, one search index, contract/gamma seed fixtures, minimal media slice registry, and short local load/repeatability probes.
principle.not_a_capacity_substitute: local-gamma does not close real-cluster measured capacity requirements such as multi-data-node sizing, multi-replica preference validation, production heap/page-cache/threadpool saturation, or production RPS/P95/P99 thresholds.

gamma_prod_consistency.summary: gamma-local and prod consistency passed: rec DNS unified, edge-media roster profile-aligned, main stack clean.

topology_and_mapping.summary: Environment topology manifest, workload topology inventory, and module package mapping passed.

gamma_verify.command: python3 agent_ops/deploy/stackctl.py verify --env gamma --kind all --tier all

mirrored: production-style edge route and port manifest
production package layout for app and services
API edge, media edge, media origin, service health, config and readonly integration probes
search-service backed by Elasticsearch and Redis in local-gamma
search baseline query, local short load probe, and single-node repeatability
minimalized_by_design: single Elasticsearch data node with one primary shard and one unassigned replica, hence yellow health
minimal contract/gamma seed knowledge scale rather than production-scale corpus
short local load duration and bounded concurrency for smoke-level methodology proof
not_verified_locally: real production or prod-sim RPS/P95/P99 capacity curve
production filesystem cache, heap, GC, search threadpool and circuit-breaker saturation point

decision.summary: local-gamma now passes the production-like minimal-scale validation. It proves mirror methodology and functional stability, but intentionally does not close true cluster capacity.
